title: Helen of Troy to Participate In The Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
summary: EL PASO, Texas, August 10, 2026--Helen of Troy Limited (NASDAQ: HELE), designer, developer, and worldwide marketer of branded consumer home, outdoor, beauty, and wellness products, announced that the Company will be participating in the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston, MA. Helen of Troy is hosting a fireside chat that is scheduled to begin at 3:30 p.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

title: OXO Brings Its Thoughtful Design Philosophy to Pet Care
summary: For more than 30 years, OXO has challenged the idea that everyday products should simply be functional. By combining thoughtful design with a deep understanding of how people live, the brand has reimagined everything from kitchen tools and coffee makers to cleaning and organization. Today, OXO brings that same approach to pet care with a new collection of feeding and food storage solutions designed to make everyday life better for pets and the people who love them.
